story.title: Whole night, moderate severity (20.4)
story.watch: Moderate night, AHI 20.4: 71/73 arousal-linked events covered with 20 separate advances, jaw forward 57% of the night against 100% for a fixed MAD.

model.pack: no hypnogram-wake (deployable), 1 Hz every cannula-valid second after 600 s lookback
model.fusion: Advance only if fire_now is above threshold (early-warn when pre_onset also high; rescue when active is also high). active-only holds if already advanced. pre_onset without fire_now does not actuate.

cohort.selection: MESA 4053 is the top-ranked of 14 held-out moderate nights (NSRR AHI 15.0-30.0) that passed the duty-cycle gates, out of 58 scored in the band. Ranking is the same as the headline night: coverage bought with as little jaw time as possible.
